calibrationOnly.definition: Never dynamic percentile tier grants; use representative authentic comparable Games to select FIXED owner-approved cutoffs.
calibrationOnly.direction: After stratified admission, for lower-is-better reverse quantiles; rare elite can also require qualitatively different predicates.
calibrationOnly.anti: Minimum opportunities, map/civ/mode cohort, per-Battle cap, no synthetic fixture positive awards

tiers.gate: First complete, fully eligible qualified performance; not a raw classifier label.
Stricter source-qualified performance or sustained consistency on same axis.
Difficult performance and additional validity/quality gate where appropriate.
Exceptionally hard corpus-calibrated performance plus relevant structural predicates; no elite from mere volume spam.

provisionalPlan.name: Drush
provisionalPlan.why: Dark Age discipline and deliberate early infantry plan, accessible before winning.
provisionalPlan.formula: One eligible standard-start Game: qualified Barracks before Feudal click; exactly three positive net distinct Dark Age Militia queue requests; Loom before Feudal click; cancellation-aware single-starting-TC workload continuity. Age clock from opening.ageUp.feudal is projected.
provisionalPlan.reject: A BUILD placement without supported Barracks identity; two Militia plus Men-at-Arms; three queued then cancelled; apparent perfect idle derived from V2 proxy alone.
provisionalPlan.expert: Drush Flush: additionally source-attributed Feudal follow-up involving correct military progression, not assumed damage.
provisionalPlan.elite: Elite Club requires exceptional fixed clock+macro gate and discipline; whether Drush Flush must be mandatory is OWNER_OPEN.
provisionalPlan.anti: Match Militia queue/cancellation and producer identity; unique Game; no repetition-only award.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Base exact-Drush qualification; calibrated Feudal clock/macro efficiency cutoffs for Practiced/Expert/Elite.

DRUSH.reason: Dark Age discipline and deliberate early infantry plan, accessible before winning.

provisionalPlan.name: Archer Rush
provisionalPlan.why: Recognizable opening with a clear skill curve.
provisionalPlan.formula: Game qualifies from source-identified Barracks→Archery Range placements and >=3 appropriate positive Archer-line unit queue requests within approved early Feudal window; score a clocked third qualified request; Age arrival is projected.
provisionalPlan.reject: Starting scout, Skirmishers, invalid unit identities, building BUILD retries or queued Archer cancellations masquerading as units produced.
provisionalPlan.expert: Early Archer continuation: correct additional ranged production/positioned directed commands attributed to same player, no alleged hits.
provisionalPlan.elite: Exceptional early-clock execution plus correct building/queue sequence and source-covered military intent.
provisionalPlan.anti: Dedupe repeated building sites and require queue windows; no proxy of units completed.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Qualified early rush; proposed fixed cutoffs calibrated to top half / top fifth / top few percent of eligible comparable openings.

ARCHER_RUSH.reason: Recognizable opening with a clear skill curve.

provisionalPlan.name: Scout Rush
provisionalPlan.formula: Game qualifies from source-identified Barracks→Stable placements and >=3 positive new Scout-line unit requests in the approved early Feudal window; rank by third qualified queue clock (not starting Scout).
provisionalPlan.reject: Starting Scout counts as trained; stable queues outside window; cancelled unit requests; no source-identifiable actor.
provisionalPlan.expert: Continued pressure signature from properly selected Scouts directed towards attributed enemy economic zone, not confirmed raid damage.
provisionalPlan.elite: Fast qualifying Feudal+Stable+Scout requests with tactical-continuation proof.
provisionalPlan.anti: Same actor/civ/patch production and at most one Game-best; no repeated clicks.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Qualified rush; fixed timing candidates derived from percentile anchors among ordinary standard-start Scout rushes.

provisionalPlan.name: Fast Castle
provisionalPlan.why: Classic AoE2 opening and an advanced economic expansion branch.
provisionalPlan.formula: Game qualifies under NORMAL_START_OPENING for lowest modelled opening.ageUp.castle.ageUpAtMs (latest Castle RESEARCH request + nominal 160s), provided click cancellation/clock are qualified.
provisionalPlan.reject: Project age arrival past source duration, canceled Castle research, same-site extra TC placement repeated, or claims of completed Castle Age/operating Town Centers.
provisionalPlan.expert: Fast Castle Boom branch: two distinct *additional* Town Center BUILD site placements in approved post-projected-Castle window.
provisionalPlan.elite: Elite Opulence requires BOTH elite Castle speed and Fast Castle Boom branch; two placed sites not finished Town Centers.
provisionalPlan.anti: Require distinct TC geometry/starting TC exclusion, qualified research trace and compatible starts.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Base valid projected FC; proposed fixed clock breakpoints from qualified normal-start Games; two-TC branch separately gated; candidate two-minute branch window not approved.

FAST_CASTLE.reason: Classic AoE2 opening and an advanced economic expansion branch.

provisionalPlan.name: Fish Boom
provisionalPlan.why: Water maps have a legitimate economic mastery path.
provisionalPlan.formula: On approved water-start Game, player.buildOrder candidate Fish Boom validated against Dock placement plus timed positive Fishing Ship queue requests and continued distinct fishing-economy signature.
provisionalPlan.reject: Dock alone, non-fishing Warship queues, Fish Traps requested but not produced/earning food, land-only random-map comparator.
provisionalPlan.expert: Two-stage sustained Fish Boom: early Dock/ship signature plus additional later economically classified water queues, not fish gathered.
provisionalPlan.elite: Exceptionally fast and varied water-economy request plan under supported water-access cohort.
provisionalPlan.anti: Water-map opportunity cohort; dedupe Dock placement retries, unit queues and source POV.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Separate water cohort timing quantiles; minimum source-covered first part of the Game; advanced branch adds continuation.

FISH_BOOM.reason: Water maps have a legitimate economic mastery path.

provisionalPlan.name: Relic Touch
provisionalPlan.why: Distinct map objective count rewards initiative, not raw APM.
provisionalPlan.formula: Best eligible Game max player.mapPresence.relicControl.uniqueRelicsTouched with known initial relic identities and complete event attribution.

provisionalPlan.expert: Earlier first source-qualified distinct relic touch in addition to more unique known relic interactions.
provisionalPlan.elite: High unique-relic coverage relative to available known relics with minimum distinct count; not impossible on sparse-relic maps.
provisionalPlan.anti: Deduplicate original relic instance ID; denominator known initial relic inventory and map class.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Base >=1 qualified unique relic interaction; later levels calibrated by number and share of available known relics.

RELIC_TOUCH.reason: Distinct map objective count rewards initiative, not raw APM.

provisionalPlan.name: Gold Control
provisionalPlan.why: Territorial macro/contestation distinct from offensive kills.
provisionalPlan.formula: Best comparable eligible Game max player.mapPresence.goldControl.controlSharePercent from deposit-weighted infrastructure influence; minimum known gold-source coverage.
provisionalPlan.reject: Claim actual gold mined, secured resources, continuous gold possession, or compare gold-light and gold-rich maps unpartitioned.
provisionalPlan.expert: Sustained gold influence variant requires newly modelled multi-time-window source geometry, not available from single snapshot.
provisionalPlan.elite: Gold influence margin above normalized equal starting share on compatible gold-spawn map with multiple qualifying influence opportunities.
provisionalPlan.anti: Map/deposit count normalization, duration floor, comparable 1v1/team/FFA split; no one-building spam.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Base qualified above an opportunity-aware baseline; freeze quantile-inspired fixed share thresholds after map cohort analysis.

GOLD_CONTROL.reason: Territorial macro/contestation distinct from offensive kills.

provisionalPlan.name: Farms at 20
provisionalPlan.why: Simple early economic development goal, useful for casual progression.
provisionalPlan.formula: From one Game's deduped Farm BUILD placements with timestamp <=1,200,000ms and recording length >=20m; no claim construction completion.
provisionalPlan.reject: Whole-Game farms substituted for at20, duplicate same-site orders, 19-minute Game treated as 0 farms.
provisionalPlan.expert: Early granary development: higher farm density by 20m with defensible Villager queue economy context; never claim food income.
provisionalPlan.elite: Exceptionally high unique Farm placement count at20 in compatible non-water-focused starts.
provisionalPlan.anti: Deduplicate placement intent and at20 cutoff; duration/excessive rebuild farming, civ/map opportunity normalization.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Owner to set four fixed 20m placement count cutoffs after corpus, no raw complete-from-one-spam.

FARMS_AT_20.reason: Simple early economic development goal, useful for casual progression.

RESOURCES_AT_20.reason: Reasonable statistic but defer to avoid 37 concurrent launch grants or unvalidated composite detector.

provisionalPlan.name: Walls
provisionalPlan.why: Accessible defensive preparation with potential expert craftsmanship.
provisionalPlan.formula: Game-best player.mapPresence.wallTiles.totalWallTiles with unique WALL tile geometry and admissible map geometry.
provisionalPlan.reject: Wall order == completed enclosure, repeated same tiles/cancellation, thousands of tiles ordered in late turtle Game as elite tactical skill.
provisionalPlan.expert: Early structured walling variation: >=2 distinct wall segments begun before a qualified attack or age-clock checkpoint, not confirmed closure.
provisionalPlan.elite: High-quality early defensive plan with diversity of wall segments/time, requiring proof beyond raw total count.
provisionalPlan.anti: Unique tile dedupe, bounded early window, no late Game count farming; avoid map size bias.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Base meaningful unique wall-tile placement; other tiers emphasize early timing+quality, not only absolute tile maximum.

WALLS.reason: Accessible defensive preparation with potential expert craftsmanship.

CASTLE_COUNT.reason: Raw count makes an easy/spammable or non-prestigious unlock; retain catalogue only.

provisionalPlan.name: Town Center Count
provisionalPlan.why: Expansion identity with clear operational planning.
provisionalPlan.formula: Count observed initially sourced starting TCs plus unique extra TC BUILD placement sites in one eligible Game, source field player.economy.townCenters.count under engine conventions; must reconcile initial+extra semantics.
provisionalPlan.reject: Claims completed/surviving TCs, same-site placement retries, count inflation from TC relocation or different starting TC cohorts.
provisionalPlan.expert: Fast expansion: additional TC distinct sites near projected Castle time under correct source identity.
provisionalPlan.elite: Exceptionally fast separate expansion sites with feasible building placement geometry; not completed boom.
provisionalPlan.anti: Starting TC count cohort, unique site dedupe, exclude Persian rebuild if model cannot disambiguate.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Base additional TC placement(s), progression by distinct extra sites plus timing; same-number retried build never advances.

TC_COUNT.reason: Expansion identity with clear operational planning.

provisionalPlan.reject: Label as army size, trained troops, military power or actual resources spent; partial unit prices reported as zero.
provisionalPlan.expert: Broad commitment: stricter at20 cost threshold AND at least two source-qualified military class families/producer requests.
provisionalPlan.elite: Exceptional comparable investment plus source-evidenced unit mix; explicit civ discount and 20m window.
provisionalPlan.anti: Separate pure quantity from strategy; use comparable format/civ and minimum opening coverage.

provisionalPlan.name: Raids Performed
provisionalPlan.why: A sustained military style, not number of villagers killed.
provisionalPlan.formula: CUMULATIVE_DISTINCT_BATTLES: one admitted opponent-attributed AOF_RAID_DETECTION_V3 raid-episode signature per distinct official Battle, with meaningful qualified hostile source commands; track number of distinct Battles with qualifying raids and separately display episodes.
provisionalPlan.reject: One Game 40 inferred episodes automatically becomes 40 career steps, or raid labels assert kills, damage, confirmed success or Cruelty.
provisionalPlan.expert: Campaign raiding: credible qualifying episodes in multiple Battles and vs more than one opponent where opportunities permit.
provisionalPlan.elite: Long-term repeated qualified campaign across varied independent Battles; no advantage from multiple POVs or single opponent farming.
provisionalPlan.anti: At most one career Battle contribution per matchId, optional per-opponent cap, minimum opportunities in fixed cohorts; no same-episode reputation inflation.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Illustrative calibration candidates for ranks: 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 distinct qualifying Battles (NOT APPROVED; Season length may require 1 / 2 / 3 / 5).

RAIDS.reason: A sustained military style, not number of villagers killed.

provisionalPlan.name: Scout Enemy
provisionalPlan.why: Scouting is strategic skill that beginners can improve.
provisionalPlan.formula: Game-best earlier starting-scout-selected MOVE/ORDER position within qualified unambiguous opponent-home geometry; supported known identity/clock; not generic any-unit player.mapPresence.enemyBaseContact.atMs.
provisionalPlan.reject: Near enemy via an Archer or Villager counts as Scout contact; position command means player saw opponent in fog; unidentified starting Scout.
provisionalPlan.expert: Earlier source-supported opponent-side Scout command contact plus coverage of distinct safe starting Scout command destinations.
provisionalPlan.elite: Elite early actionable scouting window in same start/map speed cohort and source-supported starting Scout identity.
provisionalPlan.anti: Comparable map distances/TC starts, no fake 0:00 contact from close spawns, one event per Game.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Four fixed clock thresholds derived per map-distance/start cohort, lower is faster.

SCOUT_ENEMY.reason: Scouting is strategic skill that beginners can improve.

provisionalPlan.name: Defensive Assists
provisionalPlan.why: A real fixed-team cooperative mastery track.
provisionalPlan.formula: CUMULATIVE_DISTINCT_BATTLES: count distinct official Battles with source-attributed helper->named teammate assists in verified ally-threat windows (engagementEvidence.defensiveAssistsGiven) under FIXED_TEAM_GAME; disclose 'detected intervention', not proven rescue.
provisionalPlan.reject: Being in same army area, attacking common enemy elsewhere, any ally-scored relationship Bond or a solo 1v1 equals assist.
provisionalPlan.expert: Distinctly directed assistance to more than one ally under separate real incoming threat opportunities; minimum actor command participation.
provisionalPlan.elite: Repeated independent qualified intervention across varying Battles/opponents with meaningful threat exposure; true life-saving outcome not asserted.
provisionalPlan.anti: Normalize by episodes where an eligible ally is threatened, count at most once per helper-beneficiary-raid incident per Battle and cap repeated victim farming.
provisionalPlan.pacing: Illustrative calibration 1 / 2 / 4 / 6 distinct qualifying Battles with opportunity minimum; may need lower thresholds for short Seasons.
